review.notes: All 25 physical PDF pages diffed against the OCR markdown with hyphenation-aware normalized shingle matching; every flagged fragment inspected. Four dropped footnote bodies restored (title-page correspondence note, memorization disclaimer quote on physical p.8, SDP URL on physical p.9, co-first authors note on physical p.17) and three reference line-break hyphen misjoins repaired. Every patch was verified on a rendered 300 dpi crop of its page (physical pages 1, 8, 9, 14, 15, 16, 17 read; quote glyphs in the p.8 footnote re-checked at 600 dpi and transcribed as the printed straight double quotes). Running page headers, the arXiv stamp and the copyright line are intentionally absent from the OCR. Body prose, in-text tables (Tables 1-12) and reference entries otherwise match the print; the appendix tables on physical pages 20-25 are emitted in OCR column order rather than reading order, so they were shingle-checked without a full cell-by-cell read.

unresolved.evidence: The large appendix evaluation tables (Tables 9-11 area) are emitted by OCR in column/visual order rather than reading order, so normalized shingle comparison reports transposition noise there; values were only shingle-checked, not read cell-by-cell against the rendered pages. No dropped numeric content was observed, but a cell-by-cell table review would need a dedicated pass.

Scattered axis labels and legend items (e.g. 'global only', KV-cache memory axis text, benchmark names on p.10) interleave with body text in OCR order; the source confirms they belong to the embedded figures and are not prose droppage.
